integrity: Self-contained proof based on recurrence strong divisibility, Herzog–Watanabe three-generator criterion, and canonical monomial normal forms. Exact finite Apéry checks corroborate but do not prove the all-parameter theorem. No independent audit claimed.
limitations: Even indices n>=4, u>=3, index gaps 2 and 3, and ordinary p=0 numerical semigroups only; unindexed signed-Lucas prior work not excluded.
title: Symmetry bifurcation and complete-intersection equations for Chebyshev–Lucas triples
